title: C1 — System Context
description: Employee and Admin use the shop system; Supplier and Customer interact with staff offline.

title: C2 — Complete Container View
description: Two internal roles access Web/API; API calls stateless gRPC, commits PostgreSQL transactions and publishes durable outbox events to Redis for Worker follow-up.

title: C2 — Advice and Synchronous Stock
description: A filtered Level 2 perspective shows direct Web/API/gRPC/PostgreSQL requests and where atomic stock correctness is enforced.

title: C2 — Async Replenishment and Backups
description: A filtered Level 2 perspective shows API outbox publishing, Redis consumption, persistent job state and Worker-owned backup archives.

title: Conceptual ERD — Catalogue and Trading
description: Products have SKUs; purchase and sale lines reference SKUs; receipts belong to Suppliers.

title: Conceptual ERD — Advice and Stock Control
description: A SKU has physical counts and replenishment suggestions; accepted discrepancies become adjustments and ledger entries; products carry use tags.

title: Physical DB — Products and SKU Stock
description: SKUs reference Products and an optional preferred Supplier.

title: Physical DB — Purchase Receipts
description: Lines reference Receipt and SKU; historical receipt headers reference Supplier and staff.

title: Physical DB — Sale Snapshots
description: Sale lines reference a Sales document and SKU; confirmed prices remain frozen.

title: Physical DB — Stocktaking and Audit
description: Counts and adjustments reference SKU; an approved nonzero count creates at most one adjustment.

title: Physical DB — Replenishment
description: Suggestion references SKU, optional Supplier and a linked receipt draft.

title: Physical DB — Metadata Tags and Review
description: Product/tag associations support structured advisory metadata; source review belongs to staff.

title: Physical DB — Reports, Outbox and Backup
description: Timestamped summaries reference per-SKU snapshots; outbox/job state supports async handling.
